text:
maria: FYI - noticed a cluster of tenants falling back to v1 when we flip the default route to v2. spikes in quota usage and console shows noisy alerts :eyes:
sam: hm, is that the soft-grace path or full rollback?
lee: soft-grace. routing will attempt v2 then fallback to v1-pin for 30m per token if the client header is missing.
anita: can we get a quick dump of the fail-rate distribution? rough numbers are fine.
ben: sending sample now. looks like ~6 tenants are getting >50% fallbacks for short bursts (1-2 min).
ops-bot: deploy: v2-route-default flip started (canary 5% tenants) - 2025-07-15 18:12 UTC
maria: thanks. I think two things: (1) console needs to surface the per-tenant fallback ratio (2) quota meters should exclude temporary grace fallbacks from billing alerts for 1h after flip
sam: agree on UI. current console only shows route selection counts, not persistent fallback windows.
lee: implementation-wise fallback windows are stored in the routing-proxy state as `fallback_key:expire_ts`. we can emit a telemetry tag `fallback_window=true` on routed requests.
anita: can we sketch an event schema? want to wire to dashboards and to billing-signal so alerts ignore transient spikes.
ben: proposal: add tag `route.fallback=soft-grace`, `route.fallback_owner=tenant` and `route.fallback_ttl_s` in trace attrs. quick example:```json
{
  "route.policy":"prefer-v2",
  "route.fallback":"soft-grace",
  "route.fallback_ttl_s":1800
}
```
maria: perfect. console team - can you add a per-route breakdown card showing `fallback_ratio` and a small histogram for TTLs? this should be on the rollout dashboard by EOD for the canary.
console-ui: we can add a compact widget. question: should `fallback_ratio` be computed over requests routed OR over distinct tokens/prefixes?
sam: do it over requests for now (cheaper / less state). followup: add a sampled view with distinct-token aggregation for tenants that are noisy.
lee: quick note - we'll need a migration flag in runtime to start emitting `route.fallback` tags, default off. rollout plan: 1) emit tags for canary. 2) enable telemetry aggregation pipeline to treat `soft-grace` as ignored for alerting 3) surface in console and mark billing alerts suppressed for 1h.
anita: telemetry pipeline change: add filter rule: if `route.fallback==soft-grace` and `rollout_age_s < 3600` then decrement alert score by 0.8.
ben: agree. add a sampled log event to S3 for debugging and set retention 7d.
maria: one more UX ask: console should show a small inline hint per tenant: "recently routed to v1 due to soft-grace - counts excluded from quota alerts until <time>". simple tooltip.
console-ui: doable. will add a `hint_expiry` field to the API surface.
sam: test plan: simulate route flip in staging with synthetic clients that omit version header and assert metrics change and billing alerts not firing.
lee: I'll push a staging change in the routing-proxy and add a debug endpoint: `GET /debug/fallbacks?tenant=...` returning current fallback keys.
ops-bot: deploy: routing-proxy/staging bumped -> emitting fallback tags (test) - 2025-07-15 19:04 UTC
maria: thanks team. if staging looks good we'll enable canary at 10% and watch `fallback_ratio` and billing alert rate. report any surprises in this thread. :thumbsup:
